{{Quote|At his wit's end, her father placed her in military school as a teenager. Her school records are included in the bio, but aren't much to look at.|The school is mentioned in Devidia Vennsiol's bounty posting|<ref name="BTDF">{{GamerCite|6|Bounties to Die For}}</ref>}}
A '''military school''' was attended by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Devidia Vennsiol]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. She was sent there after driving her [[Devidia Vennsiol's father|father]] to his wit's end, however while at the school she focused on little but learning how to use a range of weapons. She also used her looks and charisma to manipulate men at the school, which she found as easy as manipulating non-military boys at home on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarconia]]. She left the school with an unimpressive record and went on to rob a [[Safidine Industries]] [[Unidentified Safidine Industries laboratory|laboratory]], resulting in a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] being placed on her head.<ref name="BTDF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The school was first mentioned in the "[[Bounties to Die For]]" article in the [[Star Wars Gamer 6|sixth]] issue of [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine series. The magazines were supplements for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' and the school was included in an entry for Devidia Vennsiol which was written by [[S. Mitch Ritchie]].<ref name="BTDF" />
